title: Proof: creative diversity 63 to 92 in two months, and the first changes we recommend
hook: One brand's creative diversity score went from 63 to 92, out of 100, in two months.
caption:
One brand's creative diversity score went from 63 to 92, out of 100, in two months.
That was the score two months after they made the changes we recommended.

Why the score matters now: Meta's 'Creative diversity' column started appearing in Ads Manager in late August 2026 and reached most accounts by the last week of October. Delivery notices when your ads look alike.

Our own data shows what look-alikes cost. New ads that looked like many running ads got 36% less first-month spend.

The changes we usually recommend first:

Keep the message that already sells, and give it a new first shot.

Change the cast or the setting before rewriting the script.

Space launches out. Six look-alikes in one week compete with each other.

The score matters for what it buys: every new ad gets a fair chance to teach you something.

We'll read your account's creative diversity for free. Link in the first comment.

Follow Galvor for more results from proof season.
